purpose: Additional development inference-resolution diagnostic after the primary matched 960 experiment
motivation: Check whether retaining more image detail improves thin-stem masks without another training run
adoption_rule: Recommend 1280 for the selected fresh model only if mean native-mask IoU improves by at least 0.02 and no-output count does not increase
limitations: Repeated use of development frames for configuration selection; not an independent test or causal architecture study
